deductions: Clarity −2: “which approved options might fit” leaves a rep to infer from section 02 that the event product list is still pending.
Clarity −3: “Welcome channel partners as guests” does not make the intended treatment of a partner conversation clear.
Actionability −2: “bring in the right M2M specialist” gives no route for identifying that specialist; section 02 names contacts only for Peplink questions.
Clarity −2: “on-site networking capability” is broad enough that a rep may need a plainer example.
Actionability −6: “Leave solution design to a product specialist” and “when to hand over” do not identify a handoff route for questions outside Peplink.
Continuity −4: “If there is no agreed action, record the reason” has no matching instruction in section 04's scan-note procedure.
Clarity −2: “material need” gives little guidance on what makes a need material.
Actionability −6: The no-action path says to “record the reason” but does not say where to enter it in the lead record.
Continuity −6: “add a note with ... agreed next step” omits section 03's case where no action was agreed.
Actionability −6: The scan instructions give no field or note instruction for recording the reason when a conversation ends without an agreed action.

overall_findings: The draft does not pass: sections 02, 03 and 04 have dimensions below 95. Align the no-action capture instructions in sections 03 and 04, and specify a handoff route for specialist questions outside Peplink.
No supplied section contains a named internal customer or project, an unapproved outcome, a confidentiality contradiction, or a broken lead-save instruction.
Section 05 was not supplied, so roster and timetable preservation could not be checked.
